text:
In Washington, look for a therapist who specifically treats **body-focused repetitive behaviors (BFRBs)**—especially with **Comprehensive Behavioral Treatment (ComB), Habit Reversal Training (HRT), CBT, ACT, or ERP**.

### Washington telehealth options

- **Danielle Dorn, PsyD — The Dorn Clinic**  
  Treats **trichotillomania, skin picking, nail biting, and cheek biting** using ComB, CBT, ACT, and HRT. Listed as licensed in Washington and offering telehealth; primarily treats adults. Contact: **206-395-4524** or **info@thedornclinic.com**. ([bfrb.org](https://www.bfrb.org/medical-therapeutic-providers/danielle-dorn%2C-psy.d?utm_source=openai))

- **Jeanette Lantz, PhD — CBT Northwest**  
  Provides online-only therapy to people in Washington, using CBT, ERP, HRT, mindfulness, and ACT for hair pulling and skin picking. Contact: **253-792-1077** or **jlantz@cbtnorthwest.com**. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/providers/lantz-jeanette/?utm_source=openai))

- **Meghan Keough, PhD — Pacific Northwest Therapy**  
  Offers telehealth for OCD, trichotillomania, and other BFRBs, including CBT, ERP, and HRT. Contact: **206-531-0043** or **info@pacific-northwest-therapy.com**. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/providers/keough-meghan/?utm_source=openai))

- **David J. Kosins, PhD — Seattle**  
  Treats adults with trichotillomania and skin picking using CBT and offers teletherapy. Contact: **206-285-0900** or **dkosins@u.washington.edu**. ([bfrb.org](https://www.bfrb.org/medical-therapeutic-providers/david-j.-kosins?utm_source=openai))

- **Tory Lincoln, PhD — Lincoln Psychology**  
  Treats children, adolescents, and adults for anxiety-related conditions and BFRBs, including hair pulling and skin picking; offers telehealth to clients physically located in Washington. ([lincolnpsychology.com](https://www.lincolnpsychology.com/?utm_source=openai))

- **Lisa Shaw, PhD — Seattle Anxiety & OCD**  
  Offers remote therapy anywhere in Washington and lists trichotillomania, skin picking, and nail biting among her specialties. Contact: **425-681-3760**. ([seattleanxietyocd.com](https://www.seattleanxietyocd.com/?utm_source=openai))

- **Brian Thompson, PhD — Portland Psychotherapy**  
  Licensed for telehealth clients in Washington and Oregon and specifically treats repetitive hair pulling and skin picking. ([portlandpsychotherapy.com](https://portlandpsychotherapy.com/our-team/brian-thompson/?utm_source=openai))

- **Huiting Liu, PhD — Modern Anxiety Care**  
  Provides telehealth to adults in Washington and lists trichotillomania and excoriation/skin-picking disorder among her specialties. Contact: **206-203-1143** or **info@modernanxietycare.com**. ([modernanxietycare.com](https://www.modernanxietycare.com/?utm_source=openai))

- **Aimee McFarlane, LMHC — Seattle**  
  Offers telehealth and lists trichotillomania and skin picking among her areas of practice, primarily with adults. ([psychologytoday.com](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/therapists/aimee-mcfarlane-seattle-wa/1334718?utm_source=openai))

### Online group option

**Evergreen State Counseling** has listed a virtual six-week BFRB group for Washington adults covering skin picking, hair pulling, and nail biting using HRT. The IOCDF listing gives **Tamara Harrison** as the contact: **360-389-3703** or **tamara@evergreenstatecounseling.com**. Confirm the next group dates and availability, since groups can change. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/treatment_group/bfrb-treatment-group-for-adults-in-wa-state/?utm_source=openai))

### How to choose

When contacting them, ask:

1. “Do you regularly treat **excoriation disorder and/or trichotillomania**, rather than only general anxiety or OCD?”
2. “Do you use **ComB or HRT**?”
3. “Do you accept my insurance, or provide superbills?”
4. “Do you treat my age group, and are you currently accepting new telehealth clients?”

The **TLC Foundation** and **International OCD Foundation** directories are useful for finding additional specialists. Provider availability, fees, and insurance participation should be confirmed directly.
